name: 08202 · Avalon, NJ
findings: ZIP 08202 (Avalon) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (71%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08202 (Avalon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08202 (Avalon) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 7% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
